title: Good air flow
text: Good air flow. A little difficult to assemble, but is very quiet, has a nice air flow and handy remote control.  Moving it is easy because it is lightweight.  Happy with purchase.

product_metadata.title: Pedestal Fan - Oscillating Standing Fan with Remote Built-in Powerful 12 Speed Settings and Timer - Adjustable Height and Tilt - Quiet DC Motor Stand Floor Fan for Bedroom and Home Office Use - Black
features: 【Powerful Wind】Equipped with a DC motor to reduce noise, this quiet pedestal fan with remote control will never disturb your normal sleeping or talking. What's more, 5 upgraded aviation blades produce more powerful air speed and circulation.

【Adjustable Height & Speeds】Adjustable in height to optimize your cooling needs while you relax in your favorite chair, work at your desk, or rest for the night. Fan features 12 oscillating speeds with power off memory customize your breeze preference.
【Comfortable Experience】12 hour timer & 30s screen auto off saves energy and eliminates bothersome light while sleeping. The remote controls all functions to make operation easier.

【Stay Cool & Circulate Air】Enhance your air conditioner’s performance with this electric floor fan for your home featuring 85° oscillation and tilt head. Share the breeze with your family and save energy.
【A Safe Standing Fan for Your Family】The wide and stable base prevents tip-over. The hard self-locking cover with a tight 128 mesh ensures tiny fingers can’t be inserted.
